Name: RecipeKeep
Author: RedoClouds
Description:
RecipeKeep shows known cooking recipes that use the item selected in your hotbar. It reads the current cooking recipe data, including compatible content patches, matches category ingredients, and shows quantities per cooking. Unknown recipes are hidden.

[b]Using RecipeKeep[/b]
Press F8 to open or close the overview. Use Up/Down or the D-pad to scroll and Escape/B to close. Select a different hotbar item to update the results. The panel does not pause the world.

Use recipekeep help in the SMAPI console for commands, or recipekeep uncooked on to show recipes you have not cooked before. The open key can be changed in config.json.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. Extract the RecipeKeep folder into Mods. Keep the included Quicksan.Stardew.Common.dll beside RecipeKeep.dll. No other mod is required.

RecipeKeep does not lock, sell, destroy or transfer items, alter recipes or change game saves.

If you find bugs or problems, please report them through the Bugs or Posts tab so we can fix them. Feature requests and suggestions are welcome. Include mod, SMAPI and game versions and steps to reproduce; remove private information from logs.
